final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT rating, AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM grouped) SELECT g.rating, g.avg_ratio, g.film_count, g.avg_ratio / o.overall_avg FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
